vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: memory-dream
Version: 1.0.1

The memory-dream skill is a legitimate utility designed to consolidate an agent's daily logs into a long-term memory file (MEMORY.md). The instructions in SKILL.md and README.md define a clear, safe process for scanning recent files and performing surgical edits without deleting data or exposing secrets. No indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection were found.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and instructions match its stated purpose (consolidating memory/*.md into MEMORY.md); it is instruction-only, requests no credentials, and has no install script, but the source is unverified and the skill will read and write user memory files so you should review content and back up before enabling automated runs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the runtime instructions: the skill inventories memory/*.md, reads recent daily notes, and surgically edits MEMORY.md. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or install requirements requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to listing and reading memory files (ls memory/, read memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md, read MEMORY.md) and making precise edits to MEMORY.md, plus appending a Dream Log. This is consistent with the stated task. Caveat: reading these files can surface sensitive information (API keys, tokens, passwords) if the user has stored them in memory files; the SKILL.md includes a 'No secrets in logs' rule, but the agent cannot enforce that automatically. Review and/or scrub sensitive content in memory files before automated runs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill is instruction-only and has no install spec in the registry (lowest install risk). README suggests git clone or curl from a GitHub repo as optional manual install methods — standard but note the registry lists 'Source: unknown', so prefer installing from an audited/official repository if available.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. The operations (file reads and edits) align with the skill's purpose and do not ask for unrelated secrets or cloud credentials.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill will modify user files: it surgically edits MEMORY.md and appends a Dream Log to today's memory file, and may mark older journals as consolidated. always:false (not force-enabled). Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) — if you enable cron/heartbeat triggers it will run automatically and make persistent changes, so start with manual runs and backups.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears coherent for its stated purpose, but take these precautions before installing or enabling automatic runs:

- Source: the registry lists the skill source as unknown. If you plan to install, obtain SKILL.md (or the skill) from a trusted repository and review it first.
- Backup: make a copy of MEMORY.md and your memory/ directory before the first run so you can inspect changes or revert.
- Inspect memory files: search memory/*.md for any secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords) and remove/scrub them — the skill will read and might reference them during consolidation despite the admonition not to expose secrets.
- Dry run / manual review: run the skill manually at first and review the consolidation report and the edits to MEMORY.md; do not enable nightly cron until you are satisfied with behavior.
- Permission scope: limit the agent's file permissions if possible so the skill can only access the intended memory/ and MEMORY.md paths.
- Trustworthy install: prefer installing from an audited GitHub repo or official ClawHub package rather than arbitrary copy-paste from unknown sources.

If you want additional checks, provide the exact SKILL.md you plan to install from (or the repository URL) and I can highlight any lines that directly modify files or could leak data.
